_comment: Credentials and evidence. The credentials and the client result themselves live in commercial.json (they are Numbers Sheet A4 facts and are quoted in more than one place); this file holds the page's framing and the client-site list.
_clients_note: EMPTY BY DESIGN — docs/OPEN-ITEMS.md item 8. No client names, slugs, logos, URLs or permissions appear in any supplied file, and the one verified result is deliberately anonymous. Naming a client publicly needs their written permission, so nothing is invented here. /proof/ omits its client-sites section while this is empty, and /built-by-brandsure/ falls back to its generic version. Adding clients later is a data edit to this array and nothing else.
